items.title: Marty Napoleon interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, New York, January 16, 1999
items.q: “Jimmy Lamar.” “Hey, Jimmy, how are you?” He said, “listen, would you like to work with Charlie Barnet’s band?”

ctx.x: So anyway, with Charlie Barnet, I’m reading a Down Beat magazine and they’ve got a review of Charlie Barnet’s band in California someplace, he was playing the Palladium or

someplace, and I read the names of the guys in the band, like Barney Kessel and all these different people, guys that I know. And I said to my wife gee I’d like to play with that band you know. And the next day I get a call from a guy named — the next day — I get a call from Jimmy Lamar, a saxophone player. He didn’t go with the band but Charlie had contacted him to get some guys for the Strand Theater in New York, he was going to be there for eight weeks, eight or nine weeks. “Marty?” “Yeah.” “Jimmy Lamar.”…
